{{Quote|My people will never submit to the rule of the Emperor's craven bureaucrats.''"<br />"''Yeah? Well, when the Imperials are finished with your lovely little planet, it's gonna smell like something outta the ''Dorion Discus's'' autokitchen.''"<br />"''But armed with the Alliance weapons in your hold, my people will be a force to be reckoned with.|A Sessehshellah and a crewmember of the ''[[Dorion Discus]]''|<ref name="RoBW" />}}
'''Shaymore''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="RoBW" /> located in the [[Shaymore system/Legends|Shaymore system]], which was itself located in the [[Immerian Outback/Legends|Immerian Outback]] of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] and situated in the lee of the [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[river otter]]&ndash;like [[Sessehshellah]] [[Species/Legends|species]], and was [[Mining/Legends|mined]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] for [[hydrocarbon]]&ndash;based fossil fuels. With logistical and military support from the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], the Sessehshellah took up [[Weapon/Legends|arms]] against the Imperials, and were ultimately successful in expelling the invaders.<ref name="RoBW" />

==Locations==
A [[Unidentified Sessehshellah village|Sessehshellah village]] was situated on Shaymore, as was at least one stretch of [[Swamp/Legends|marshes]]. During the Galactic Empire's settlement of the world, several [[Refinery/Legends|refineries]] were established to support the Imperial extraction effort.<ref name="RoBW" />

==Behind the scenes==
Shaymore first appeared in "[[Rings of Bright Water]]", an adventure written by [[Ken Rolston]] and collected in the [[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|first edition]] of ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' in [[October]] [[1987]].<ref name="RoBW" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Shaymore system in grid square N-14.<ref name="TEA" />
